action.command:
docker run --rm --entrypoint sh quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.1.2 -c '
ls /opt/keycloak/lib/
find /opt/keycloak -name "messages*.properties" 2>/dev/null | head
find / -name "keycloak-services*.jar" 2>/dev/null | head -3
' 2>&1

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "docker run --rm --entrypoint sh quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.1.2 -c '
